meta.title: Add GPU shader plugins and adaptive capture improvements
meta.body_summary: Add GPU shader plugin system (createWebGLProcessor), adaptive resolution flags in CLI, capture metrics in VR HUD/remote pages, and a sample invert plugin.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit PR adding GPU plugin and metrics; self-merged in ~51s with no review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 126 changed lines across 8 files, this is a small-sized edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, feature addition PR that was self-merged quickly without review, consistent with low-friction merge.

review_details.performance_claim: GPU plugin system, adaptive resolution, and capture metrics aim to improve processing performance and visualization.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: This PR illustrates a process boundary where an agent-authored multi-feature PR can be self-merged without any human review, indicating low friction but also lack of oversight on performance claims.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or repro steps for performance impacts; only narrative claims in PR summary.

core_change_summary.description: Adds GPU shader plugin support via createWebGLProcessor, exposes adaptive resolution flags in the CLI tool, displays capture metrics in VR HUD and remote control pages, and includes an example invert shader plugin.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Viewer.html and remote-control.html updated for metrics display; docs and tests updated for new CLI options.
